title: (RHBA-2020:3454) Update to Fuse 7.7.0 images
portal_summary: Updated fuse7/fuse-eap-openshift container image is now available for RHEL-7 based Middleware Containers.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.10|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.11|x86_64
portal_solution:
This release consists of the following parts:
* Fuse Apicurito image (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
* Fuse Console Operator image (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
* Fuse Postgres Exporter image (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
portal_description: This advisory makes available updates to the Fuse Postgres Exporter, Apicurito, and Fuse Console Operator images for Red Hat Fuse 7.7.0.
abstract: This advisory makes available updates to the Fuse Postgres Exporter, Apicurito, and Fuse Console Operator images for Red Hat Fuse 7.7.0.
